  "summary": "This five-page archival file preserves a Swatantra Party telegram to M. R. Masani, together with related correspondence from November–December 1975. The telegram invites Masani to accept a private lunch at Woodlands Hotel, Mylapore, on 8 December at 1 p.m. The accompanying Swatantra Party letter confirms arrangements for a public meeting in Madras connected with Rajaji’s birthday: K. Subba Rao was expected to preside, Shanti Bhushan and Masani were to deliver special addresses, and other named participants were assigned welcome and vote-of-thanks duties.\n\nThe supporting correspondence also records Masani’s travel plans and logistical arrangements for a Simon Garves Attitude Survey in Calcutta, including scheduled flights and interviews with eighteen people. A second telegram receipt repeats the invitation to the Madras meeting and adds an invitation to cocktails with a visiting director from England. The pages also include the reverse side of the Indian Posts and Telegraphs form, containing standard instructions and liability conditions. The filename date does not correspond to the dates visible on the documents, which are concentrated in late November and early December 1975.",
